item.title: [11.11 Exclusive Bundle] Cetaphil Best Selling Cleanser Twin Bundle (Gentle Skin Cleanser 1.25L x2)
item.description:
In This Bundle you will get:
1. Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser 1.25L Twin Pack  
1. Cetaphil Soothing & Comforting Serum 5ml GWP
1. Cetaphil Pro Ad Derma Wash 29ml GWP

1. CETAPHIL GENTLE SKIN CLEANSER: Clinically proven to cleanse while hydrating, providing 48 hours of hydration when wiped off versus rinsing
2. IDEAL FOR DRY TO NORMAL, SENSITIVE SKIN: Hydrates and soothes as it cleanses, preserving skin's moisture barrier, even after repeat washes
3. NEW AND IMPROVED INGREDIENT BLEND: Now with hydrating glycerin and skin essential vitamin B3 (niacinamide) and pro-vitamin B5 (panthenol)
4. DEVELOPED FOR EVEN THE MOST SENSITIVE SKIN: The hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic formula is free of fragrances, parabens and sulfates
5. FROM THE #1 DERMATOLOGIST RECOMMENDED FACIAL SKINCARE BRAND
6. DEFENDS AGAINST 5 SIGNS OF SKIN SENSITIVITY: Dryness, irritation, roughness, tightness and a weakened skin barrier

Be kind to your sensitive skin with CETAPHIL Gentle Skin Cleanser, a creamy, non-foaming daily facial cleanser that's ideal for dry to normal skin types. This gentle yet effective face was uses micellar technology to remove dirt, makeup and impurities while hydrating the skin. Formulated with a new blend of key ingredients: hydrating glycerin, panthenol (pro-vitamin B5) to hydrate, soothe and preserve the skin barrier, and niacinamide (vitamin B3) to help smooth skin's texture and retain skin's moisture barrier. It hydrates and soothes as it cleans to maintain the skin's natural moisture barrier and provide 48 hours of hydration when wiped off, helping to defend against 5 signs of skin sensitivity. Hypoallergenic, soap free, fragrance free, paraben free and sulfate free to clean without irritation and without clogging pores, leaving your skin feeling soft and smooth. Clincially tested for even the most sensitive skin.

Directions: 
Cleansing without water: Apply cleanser using hands or a facial cotton pad (recommended). Gently smooth all over face to remove excess oil, impurities and makeup. If using hands to apply, wipe away with cotton pad or towel. Repeat if necessary until skin looks cleansed. Cleanse without rinsing for 48 hour hydration.

Cleansing with water: Apply cleanser using hands or a facial cotton pad (recommended). Gently smooth all over face to remove excess oil, impurities and makeup. Repeat if necessary. Rinse with warm water and gently pat dry for 24 hour hydration.

Caution: 
For external use only.

Storage:
Store below 30 degrees C

Ingredients:
AQUA, GLYCERIN, CETEARYL ALCOHOL, PANTHENOL, NIACINAMIDE, PANTOLACTONE, XANTHAN GUM, SODIUM COCOYL ISETHIONATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, CITRIC ACID. FIL.1747.V00
